summary: Keep browser outbox identity observations ordered by read start

replay.detail: No replay behavior changes; unknown attempts remain non-retryable.

schema.detail: No browser or server storage schema changes; ordering metadata is in memory only.

compatibility.detail: Startup, grants and scoped discovery reserve monotonic observation sequences before reading capabilities. Older responses cannot replace a newer scope or initialize an obsolete repository. Grants recheck observation freshness after initialization.

recovery.detail: A delayed protected startup response cannot move an already initialized protected or explicitly unprotected browser identity backward. Persisted scope tuples are unchanged.
